messages.subject: [adegenet-forum] Compoplot sorting x axis
messages.body_plain:
Hello! I'm trying to plot out the results of my DAPC using compoplot and I
keep getting a plot with the clusters intermixed (the axis is sorted by the
populations and not by the clusters). How can I rearrange the order of the
plot?

Thank you!
Caroline Burks
